title: The Silent Hollow
author: Sebastian Galloway
blurb: Sable Ravensworth, a thief who steals memories, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
